description:
Music video animated by Osare-P for the song Bungaku Shounen no Yuuutsu by Hoehoe-P.

There are two versions of this song, the original music video was uploaded on January 10, 2010, and features vocals by Miku Hatsune, while the other version was uploaded on June 29, 2011, and features vocals by Nanou's band, Lyu:Lyu (now CIVILIAN).
